judgements.justification: YbwL raised to 6 at confidence 4 because a misreading was cleared, not because it could not check the core; the confidence-3 reviewers did not move.
Both committees saw the paper's own learning-augmented framing; A required a robustness analysis and consistency-robustness trade-off, while B called robustness trivial or a revision item.
No reviewer's praise rested on a wrong factual claim; YbwL's claim that the experiments show superiority holds in a narrow sense.
No A reviewer replied after the rebuttal, and B's YbwL raised its score once its concern was resolved.

A's chair judged the submission, which does not address inaccurate predictions, and ignored the rebuttal's (1+ε) sketch; B's chair accepted and made the incorrect-prediction point a final-version item.
No reviewer stated a position that differed from an unedited score.
No extra reviewer was called in by either chair.
Clarity complaints came from both committees (upZi in A; YbwL and ZGPi in B) and did not separate them.
YbwL's raise came with a stated reason; no score was raised silently.
Neither chair discounted a rating because its reviewer was silent.
A also had a 7 (upZi), and B's 8 came at confidence 3 with the math not checked.
No reviewer admitted reading only part of the paper.
A's reviewers applied the learning-augmented standard that the paper's own introduction invokes, not a different theoretical tradition.
B's three-sentence meta-review called the paper 'technically strong and interesting' and gave no reason for a spotlight over two confidence-4 ratings of 6.

Only A's reviewers checked the baseline against the learning-augmented literature and asked for a prediction-aware one; B's reviewers checked derivations and called the ZCL-only experiments well designed.
A's meta-review is accurate for the submission and does not contradict the forum record.
Venue doubt arose in both committees (K1Av in A, ZGPi in B), and it did not cap B's tier.
The misreading detractor (K1Av) sat in the rejecting committee; no chair defended acceptance against it.
Both committees received the same rebuttal points, including the (1+ε) sketch; no new results went to one forum only.
B's confidence-4 reviewers rated the paper lower than its confidence-3 reviewers, the reverse of this mechanism.
No objection or score change came after the response period.
B's ZGPi shared K1Av's venue and motivation doubts and did not fully understand the gain, yet gave 6 to K1Av's 4; et4L gave 7 on one paragraph.
A's K1Av called the learning-augmented framing 'misleading', xbrn called it 'incomplete', and A's chair doubted it is a learning-augmented algorithm; B took the framing at face value.
B's unsure reviewers gave 7 and 8, not flat marginal scores, and B's chair gave a spotlight, not a poster.
